name: reliquary
description: Connect Codex to Reliquary: the MCP connection, a skill for working in a vault, and a brief of what changed when a session starts in a project linked to a vault.

interface.shortDescription: The shared vault of context for people and their agents.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Reliquary with OAuth sign-in, adds a skill for working in a vault, and in a project whose .reliquary.json names a vault, starts each session with a short brief and reminds the agent to propose an update after git push.
